notes.content:
Content changes:
[list]
[*]New level "I'm Dreaming of Home". On the other side of the galaxy with only PZO-116 for company, Ace imagines what the celebrations would be like if they were to ever make it back to Earth.
[/list]

Bug Fixes:
[list]
[*] Fixed youtube streaming
[/list]

notes.title: Bass Invaders Demo - Out Now!
notes.content:
I have made a demo so you can try out the game for free.

Here's what you get:
[list]
[*] The first couple of campaign levels and songs
[*] All the tutorials
[*] Full two-player co-op support
[*] Save files carry over to full game
[*] Restricted to three custom songs
[*] No leaderboards
[*] No achievements (any progress-based achievements will be unlocked when you upgrade to the full game)
[*] Semi-annoying nag screens asking you to buy the full game
[/list]
If you like the demo and want to move to the full game, I'd say around the end of June or beginning of July would be an excellent time to do it...
